value="<font style="font-size:9px" color="#6B7280"><b>Docker network edge</b> joins nginx, the backend, the Collector, the trace check tool and Langfuse web. Each project also has a private network. No store has a published port.<br><br><b>Volumes</b>: collector-data (owner set by collector-init), postgres-data, clickhouse-data, clickhouse-logs, minio-data. The trace check tool mounts collector-data read-only.<br><br><b>Secrets</b>: host files with mode 600 (backend.env, collector.env, check.env, langfuse.env) and the S1-11 password files, not in git.<br><br>Langfuse web and worker both use all four stores.</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="310" width="150" x="712" y="390" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon-gcp-vm-164" value="<b>Firewall (ingress)</b> &nbsp; 80 from the job subnet. 3000 and 22 from the IAP range only. The database ports on the VM are never open. Cloud SQL has a private IP only and accepts only TLS.<br><br><b>Test host only (decided 2026-10-08)</b> &nbsp; No DNS name, no HTTPS and no dashboard SSO: the API key and the OTLP token go over the VPC without TLS. The keys are test-host keys; production uses other keys.<br><br><b>Not on the test host yet</b> &nbsp; The staff dashboard (S2-07); its planned host port 8080 is not the 8080 inside the nginx container. The backend's spans and scores to Langfuse (S2-05). div.font:
Docker network edge joins nginx, the backend, the Collector, the trace check tool and Langfuse web. Each project also has a private network. No store has a published port.
Volumes: collector-data (owner set by collector-init), postgres-data, clickhouse-data, clickhouse-logs, minio-data. The trace check tool mounts collector-data read-only.
Secrets: host files with mode 600 (backend.env, collector.env, check.env, langfuse.env) and the S1-11 password files, not in git.
Langfuse web and worker both use all four stores.

div.div:
Firewall (ingress) 80 from the job subnet. 3000 and 22 from the IAP range only. The database ports on the VM are never open. Cloud SQL has a private IP only and accepts only TLS.
Test host only (decided 2026-10-08) No DNS name, no HTTPS and no dashboard SSO: the API key and the OTLP token go over the VPC without TLS. The keys are test-host keys; production uses other keys.
Not on the test host yet The staff dashboard (S2-07); its planned host port 8080 is not the 8080 inside the nginx container. The backend's spans and scores to Langfuse (S2-05). The first real job run waits for the job side (S1-02a, S1-03).

div.div:
Data scope in October: identity-only
Each job sends the run identity, the counts, the status and the times (records: []), and one trace for each run. GCP spans contain no text. No customer data and no customer text reach the monitor. There is no judge and no LiteLLM call. Decided 2026-10-09; risk tier R1. Before SEND_RECORDS goes on or the judge starts, gates 3, 6 and 7 examine the change again. The monitor advises people. It never changes or stops a model or a job.
